t: A tiny, low-cost FPGA board with HDMI out and a camera connector.
steps: Buy the board, with or without the OV2640 camera, from a seller such as Spotpear or the Sipeed AliExpress store.
Install the open tools Yosys, nextpnr, and openFPGALoader, or the free Gowin EDA IDE.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Download the TangNano-4K-example repo from Sipeed.
Build and flash the led_test example.
Connect a monitor and try the hdmi_720p example.
Add the camera and run the camera_hdmi example.
